title: Authorized Resident Core Retrieval
summary: P2 binds reviewed project routes to the existing Core API and bounds retained immutable candidate generations without reusing source-currentness claims; P3D2 selects them only through a PostgreSQL active-generation reference.

configuration.compatibility: Current Server configuration is v10; historical v8 and v9 are rejected. Preserve the independent database identity pin database.server_id, reviewed source_host_id/workspace bindings, observability, explicit knowledge and journal_writer policies. Optional receipt_producer defaults false, including admins. Use the current template, explicit private v9-to-v10 transition and binary check-config gate in shin-companion-protocols-v1; no implicit migration, identity adoption or compatibility reader.
configuration.observabilityPolicy: Exact required fields: max_retained_requests 0..256, max_query_bytes 1..8192, capture_query_projects at most 32 unique valid project IDs. Wildcards and capture with zero retention are rejected. Empty capture is metadata-only; opt-in query diagnostics may contain sensitive input and are not a secret scrubber. See shin-retrieval-observability-v1 for process-local retention and measurement boundaries.
configuration.routePolicy: At most 32 unique routes. Config source_host_id and explicit workspace_id must match the registered local binding; there is no implicit primary route. Paths are canonical existing allowlisted directories; profile bytes are pinned at startup. Root dev:ino must match the workspace registry and live root on each request. Git is not required.
configuration.authority: Routes are reviewed operator configuration, not caller-supplied filesystem paths. A registered project is not automatically adopted or indexed. Active artifacts are private server-owned preparation artifacts selected by the PostgreSQL route reference, never a configured CLI out_dir. Exact-current admission separately verifies the live root against the selected snapshot.
configuration.updates: Review configuration/profile changes and restart explicitly. Reads never repair routes, register projects, build indexes or publish snapshots. Migration 004 establishes DB route heads and receipts; migration 005 adds the typed audit receipt link without rewriting applied 004. The activation API is the only active-generation authority; CLI publications never establish Server authority.

POST /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/route.result: Core search evidence under result.evidence with the documented Server transport projection.
Core compact Brief under result.evidence; per-document limit 2.
Core compact Pack under result.evidence, single-job execution. Inspect completion independently of HTTP success.

api.GET /api/v1/cache: Administrator-only aggregate in-process counters; no source, queries, route paths or per-principal activity.
api.transportProjection: P3E11 omits top-level CLI-local root/out_root from every transported Core envelope. Canonical evidence records, verification paths, requirements and receipt hashes stay unchanged. CLI/server parity compares this explicit projection, not a silently redacted evidence set.
api.admission: require_current defaults true and admission=exact-current. Explicit false selects snapshot-only and Core freshness remains not-assessed/current=false/fully_verified=false. No fallback from failed currentness.
api.authorization: Authenticate first. Query the PostgreSQL scoped project registry before inspecting route files. Denied or absent project returns 404. Missing or wrong-project route returns 404. Database outage blocks retrieval even for a resident generation.
api.errors: Return stable reason codes, not Core exception messages containing paths or input snippets. A route at revision 0 or explicitly deactivated has no active generation and returns 503/active-generation-missing. Stale/current-generation/root/profile conflicts are 409; cache pressure or unavailable index may be 503; invalid request is 400; output ceiling is 413.
api.observability: shin-retrieval-observability-v1 defines admin-only fixed-cardinality service metrics and bounded process-local diagnostics. Capturing query/task JSON requires an explicit project allowlist; metadata is the default. No response body change, extra retrieval or durable telemetry sink.
api.journal: P3E15 provides a separate explicit admin capture into typed PostgreSQL facts and bounded analytical reports; see shin-retrieval-journal-v1. Ordinary retrieval and diagnostic reads do not write it. This is not continuous/lossless telemetry delivery.
notProvided: arbitrary CLI flags or input paths

residency.key: Active artifact owner preparation_id plus artifact_key, route identity and exact manifest snapshot id. Different preparations never share an owner merely because manifest ids coincide.
residency.admission: Read the DB active reference, hold its candidate shared lifetime lock, then recheck the reference before loading its private artifact. A cold load verifies and captures one full immutable generation and must match the selected id. A changed reference at the admission recheck returns conflict. After that boundary an admitted reader may finish its original generation even when the head advances; its response identifies that admitted preparation and revision. Exact-current uses a new Core admission proof on every request.
residency.budget: Reserve the full per-generation payload cap before cold loading. At most one cold load globally; duplicate misses coalesce with a bounded 500ms wait. Warm hits do not wait for unrelated loads. Load failures release reservations after discarding temporary owners.
residency.eviction: Evict least-recently-used inactive entries only. A request-held old generation remains in the collection and byte/count accounting until it can be evicted. A load that cannot reserve within both aggregate caps returns snapshot-cache-busy.
residency.limits: Aggregate stored payload <=1GiB, generation <=aggregate, file <=generation, retained generation count 1..32. Config defaults are not measured SLOs. Payload accounting excludes JSON/container overhead, verification temporary allocations, manifest probes and request objects; it is not an RSS or total allocator cap.
residency.locking: No cache mutex is held across filesystem loading, database calls, source-currentness assessment or retrieval. Publication locks are not retained by cache entries.
residency.freshnessCost: The existing strict Core algorithm regenerates expected outputs for exact currentness. RAM residency does not remove this CPU cost and cannot turn an old current=true result into a reusable proof.

operationalBoundary: Local authenticated development service with trusted reviewed profiles and filesystem ownership. Socket timeouts are not CPU cancellation or an end-to-end deadline. Per-project fairness, long soak, hostile local filesystem races, remote clients and publication jobs need later gates before production cutover.
readiness: GET /health/ready still means database/schema readiness only. Retrieval requires an explicit DB active generation; an initial route or explicit deactivation is unavailable. Retrieval availability and currentness are proved by the selected request, not by liveness or cache counters.
